subtitle.ms: Skematik pembelajaran generik, bukan susun atur peralatan yang disahkan
subtitle.en: Generic learning schematic, not a verified equipment layout

fallbackExplain.ms: Peranti ini tidak menyokong AR, jadi paparan 2D digunakan. Kandungan pembelajarannya sama.
fallbackExplain.en: This device does not support AR, so the 2D view is shown. The learning content is the same.

function.ms: Membekalkan gerakan mekanikal dalam sistem generik ini.
function.en: Provides mechanical motion in this generic system.

purpose.ms: Perhati dan rekod hanya keadaan luaran yang dibenarkan. Keperluan akses selamat dan pengadang mesti disahkan.
purpose.en: Observe and record only the permitted external condition. Safe access and guarding requirements must be verified.

observe.ms: Pengadang gandingan berada di tempatnya dan tidak rosak.
observe.en: Coupling guard is in place and undamaged.

observe.ms: Plat nama motor boleh dibaca; rekod seperti yang tertera.
observe.en: Motor nameplate is legible; record it as marked.

observe.ms: Keadaan luaran kabel dan kotak terminal, tanpa sentuhan.
observe.en: External condition of the cable and terminal box, without contact.

observe.ms: Bunyi, getaran, bau atau perubahan warna yang luar biasa: huraikan sahaja, jangan ukur tanpa kebenaran.
observe.en: Unusual noise, vibration, smell or discolouration: describe only; do not measure without authorisation.

doNot.ms: Jangan sentuh atau menghulurkan tangan ke arah bahagian berputar.
doNot.en: Do not touch or reach towards rotating parts.

doNot.ms: Jangan buka, alih atau mengintai di sebalik pengadang.
doNot.en: Do not open, remove or look behind the guard.

doNot.ms: Jangan sentuh permukaan motor kerana mungkin panas.
doNot.en: Do not touch the motor surface; it may be hot.

commonMistakes.en: Assuming the guard is in place without checking.

commonMistakes.ms: Menulis "OK" tanpa menghuraikan apa yang diperhatikan.
commonMistakes.en: Writing "OK" without describing what was observed.

question.ms: Semasa pemeriksaan, anda dapati pengadang gandingan tiada. Apakah tindakan anda?
question.en: During the inspection you find the coupling guard missing. What do you do?

text.ms: Teruskan pemeriksaan dengan berhati-hati.
text.en: Continue the inspection carefully.

feedback.ms: Tidak selamat. Pengadang yang tiada ialah keadaan tidak selamat.
feedback.en: Unsafe. A missing guard is an unsafe condition.

text.ms: Henti, jauhkan diri dan laporkan kepada penyelia dengan segera.
text.en: Stop, keep clear and report to the supervisor immediately.

feedback.ms: Betul. Jangan teruskan sehingga keadaan dinilai oleh orang diberi kuasa.
feedback.en: Correct. Do not continue until an authorised person has assessed the condition.

text.ms: Pasang semula pengadang sendiri.
text.en: Refit the guard yourself.

feedback.ms: Tidak. Kerja pemasangan di luar skop pemerhatian dan memerlukan kebenaran serta pengasingan.
feedback.en: No. Fitting work is outside the observation scope and needs authorisation and isolation.

note.ms: Arah putaran dan butiran pemacu tidak disahkan daripada ilustrasi.
note.en: Rotation direction and drive details are not verified from the illustration.

function.en: Transfers fluid through the conceptual system.

purpose.ms: Kenal pasti tag peralatan, skop tugas dan titik pemerhatian yang dibenarkan.
purpose.en: Identify the equipment tag, task scope and authorised observation points.

observe.ms: Tag peralatan pada plat tag; rekod dengan tepat.
observe.en: Equipment tag on the tag plate; record it exactly.

observe.ms: Kesan kebocoran yang kelihatan di sambungan bebibir dan sekitar pam.
observe.en: Visible signs of leakage at flanged connections and around the pump.

observe.ms: Keadaan luaran kaki dan pengikat pada rangka asas.
observe.en: External condition of the feet and fixings on the base frame.

observe.ms: Kedudukan injap: rekod seperti ditemui sahaja.
observe.en: Valve positions: record as found only.

doNot.ms: Jangan laraskan injap atau sebarang kawalan.
doNot.en: Do not adjust valves or any controls.
Do not open covers or connections.

doNot.ms: Jangan andaikan identiti port sedutan atau discas.
doNot.en: Do not assume which port is suction or discharge.

commonMistakes.ms: Menggunakan nama umum "pam" tanpa tag peralatan.
commonMistakes.en: Using the generic name "pump" without the equipment tag.

commonMistakes.ms: Mendekati peralatan sebelum skop dan titik pemerhatian disahkan.
commonMistakes.en: Approaching before the scope and observation points are confirmed.

question.ms: Apakah yang mesti disahkan sebelum mendekati pam?
question.en: What must be confirmed before approaching the pump?

text.ms: Tag peralatan, skop tugas dan titik pemerhatian yang dibenarkan.
text.en: The equipment tag, task scope and authorised observation points.

feedback.ms: Betul. Ketiga-tiganya menentukan apa yang boleh anda perhati dan rekod.
feedback.en: Correct. All three define what you may observe and record.

text.ms: Kelajuan operasi pam.
text.en: The pump's operating speed.

feedback.ms: Kelajuan operasi tidak dibekalkan dan bukan prasyarat pemerhatian luaran.
feedback.en: Operating speed is not supplied and is not a prerequisite for external observation.

text.ms: Jenis pendesak di dalam pam.
text.en: The type of impeller inside the pump.

feedback.ms: Binaan dalaman tidak disahkan dan tidak diperlukan untuk pemerhatian luaran.
feedback.en: Internal construction is not verified and is not needed for external observation.

note.ms: Jenis pam, binaan dalaman serta identiti port sedutan dan discas tidak disahkan.
note.en: Pump type, internal construction and suction/discharge port identities are not verified.

purpose.ms: Rekod titik, nilai, unit, masa dan rujukan. Tiada had yang diluluskan dibekalkan.
purpose.en: Record point, value, unit, time and reference. No approved limits are supplied.

observe.ms: Tag instrumen dan label kalibrasi; rekod status seperti yang tertera.
observe.en: Instrument tag and calibration label; record the status as marked.

observe.ms: Unit dan resolusi skala yang tertera pada dail.
observe.en: Unit and scale resolution marked on the dial.

observe.ms: Sama ada jarum stabil atau berayun.
observe.en: Whether the needle is steady or fluctuating.

observe.ms: Keadaan kaca dail: retak atau berkabus.
observe.en: Dial glass condition: cracked or fogged.

doNot.en: Do not tap the dial to "free" the needle.
Do not estimate or round the value.

doNot.ms: Jangan nilai bacaan sebagai normal atau tidak normal tanpa had yang diluluskan.
doNot.en: Do not judge a reading as normal or abnormal without approved limits.

commonMistakes.ms: Merekod masa mengisi borang, bukan masa bacaan diambil.
commonMistakes.en: Recording the time of writing instead of the time of reading.

question.ms: Bagaimanakah cara terbaik mengelakkan ralat paralaks?
question.en: How do you best avoid parallax error?

text.ms: Baca pada aras mata, tegak lurus dengan dail.
text.en: Read at eye level, square to the dial.

feedback.ms: Betul. Mata sejajar dengan jarum menghapuskan sudut bacaan.
feedback.en: Correct. Aligning your eye with the needle removes the viewing angle.

text.ms: Baca dari sisi supaya jarum lebih jelas.
text.en: Read from the side so the needle is clearer.

feedback.ms: Membaca dari sisi menyebabkan paralaks.
feedback.en: Reading from the side causes parallax.

text.ms: Ambil purata bacaan rakan sekumpulan.
text.en: Take the average of your group's readings.

feedback.ms: Setiap pemerhati merekod bacaan sendiri; jangan salin nilai.
feedback.en: Each observer records their own reading; do not copy values.

note.ms: Dail model tidak bertanda; tiada nilai atau had dibekalkan. Penunjuk disambung melalui tapping dan bukan komponen aliran terus.
note.en: The model's dial is unmarked; no values or limits are supplied. The indicator is connected through a tapping and is not a through-flow component.

function.ms: Mewakili pemindahan haba dalam peta pembelajaran.
function.en: Represents heat transfer in the learning map.

purpose.ms: Kenal pasti di mana pemerhatian suhu dan air yang diluluskan akan direkodkan.
purpose.en: Identify where approved temperature and water observations would be recorded.

observe.ms: Titik pemerhatian suhu atau air yang diluluskan, jika ada.
observe.en: Approved temperature or water observation points, if any.

observe.ms: Kebocoran yang kelihatan pada sambungan paip ke modul.
observe.en: Visible leakage at the pipe connections to the module.

observe.ms: Halangan pada sirip atau kipas, tanpa sentuhan.
observe.en: Obstruction of the fins or fan, without contact.

doNot.ms: Jangan rekod suhu di titik yang tidak diluluskan.
doNot.en: Do not record temperatures at points that are not approved.

doNot.ms: Jangan andaikan warna paip menunjukkan suhu.
doNot.en: Do not assume pipe colour indicates temperature.
Do not touch surfaces or the fan.

commonMistakes.ms: Menganggap paip merah bermaksud panas dan paip biru bermaksud sejuk.
commonMistakes.en: Assuming the red pipe means hot and the blue pipe means cold.

commonMistakes.ms: Meninggalkan medan kosong dan bukannya menulis "tiada titik diluluskan".
commonMistakes.en: Leaving the field blank instead of writing "no approved points".

question.ms: Tiada titik suhu yang diluluskan untuk peralatan ini. Apakah yang anda tulis?
question.en: There are no approved temperature points for this equipment. What do you write?

text.ms: "Tiada titik diluluskan", kemudian maklumkan penyelia.
text.en: "No approved points", then inform the supervisor.

feedback.ms: Betul. Rekod yang jelas lebih baik daripada medan kosong.
feedback.en: Correct. A clear entry is better than a blank field.

text.ms: Anggaran suhu berdasarkan sentuhan.
text.en: An estimated temperature based on touch.

feedback.ms: Tidak selamat dan bukan bukti yang sah.
feedback.en: Unsafe, and not valid evidence.

text.ms: Biarkan medan itu kosong.
text.en: Leave the field blank.

feedback.ms: Medan kosong tidak dapat dibezakan daripada terlupa mengisi.
feedback.en: A blank field cannot be told apart from a forgotten one.

note.ms: Laluan aliran dalaman penukar haba tidak disahkan. Anak panah aliran dalam model adalah konseptual.
note.en: The heat exchanger's internal flow path is not verified. Flow arrows in the model are conceptual.

function.en: Connects observations to the inspection record.

purpose.ms: Rekod dapatan, ketidakpastian, rujukan sumber dan orang diberi kuasa yang dimaklumkan.
purpose.en: Record findings, uncertainty, source references and the authorised person informed.

observe.ms: Semua medan rekod lengkap, termasuk unit dan masa.
observe.en: All record fields are complete, including unit and time.
The latest reading is clearly marked.

doNot.en: Do not hand over verbally only.

doNot.ms: Jangan membuat penilaian trend tanpa had yang diluluskan.
doNot.en: Do not judge trends without approved limits.

doNot.ms: Jangan ubah entri lama; buat entri baharu bersama masa.
doNot.en: Do not alter earlier entries; make a new, timed entry.

commonMistakes.ms: Tidak menyebut ketidakpastian atau perkara yang belum disahkan.
commonMistakes.en: Not mentioning uncertainty or unverified items.

question.ms: Apakah komunikasi gelung tertutup semasa serahan?
question.en: What is closed-loop communication during handover?

text.ms: Penerima mengulang semula maklumat utama untuk pengesahan.
text.en: The receiver repeats the key information back for confirmation.

feedback.ms: Betul. Ini memastikan maklumat diterima dengan tepat.
feedback.en: Correct. It confirms the information was received accurately.

text.ms: Menghantar mesej tanpa menunggu balasan.
text.en: Sending a message without waiting for a reply.

feedback.ms: Tiada pengesahan, jadi gelung tidak tertutup.
feedback.en: There is no confirmation, so the loop is not closed.

text.ms: Menyerahkan borang tanpa sebarang penerangan.
text.en: Handing over the form without any explanation.

feedback.ms: Borang perlu disertai penerangan ringkas dan pengesahan penerima.
feedback.en: The form needs a brief explanation and the receiver's confirmation.

note.ms: Kandungan prosedur ini perlu disemak terhadap prosedur serahan jabatan.
note.en: This procedural content must be checked against the department's handover procedure.

label.en: Clip 6, step 5: record and hand over

situation.ms: Jarum penunjuk tekanan berayun dan tidak stabil semasa anda membaca.
situation.en: The pressure indicator needle is fluctuating while you read it.

text.ms: Rekod nilai tertinggi sahaja.
text.en: Record only the highest value.

feedback.ms: Satu nilai terpilih tidak mewakili apa yang diperhatikan.
feedback.en: A single chosen value does not represent what was observed.

text.ms: Rekod seperti yang ditetapkan oleh prosedur, catat "jarum berayun" dalam ketidakpastian, dan maklumkan penyelia.
text.en: Record as the procedure requires, note "needle fluctuating" under uncertainty, and inform the supervisor.

feedback.ms: Betul. Keadaan sebenar direkod dan orang diberi kuasa dimaklumkan.
feedback.en: Correct. The actual condition is recorded and the authorised person is informed.

text.ms: Ketuk dail sehingga jarum stabil.
text.en: Tap the dial until the needle settles.

feedback.ms: Jangan ketuk instrumen; ia boleh menjejaskan bacaan dan instrumen.
feedback.en: Do not tap the instrument; it can affect both the reading and the instrument.

situation.ms: Anda telah merekod bacaan, tetapi tiada had yang diluluskan dibekalkan.
situation.en: You have recorded a reading, but no approved limits are supplied.

text.ms: Tulis "normal" kerana nilainya kelihatan munasabah.
text.en: Write "normal" because the value looks reasonable.

feedback.ms: "Normal" hanya boleh ditentukan berdasarkan had yang diluluskan.
feedback.en: "Normal" can only be decided against approved limits.

text.ms: Rekod seperti ditemui, tulis "Tiada had dibekalkan", dan rujuk kepada orang diberi kuasa.
text.en: Record as found, write "No limits supplied", and refer to the authorised person.

feedback.ms: Betul. Keputusan dibuat oleh orang diberi kuasa berdasarkan sumber yang sah.
feedback.en: Correct. The authorised person decides, based on a valid source.

text.ms: Bandingkan dengan bacaan rakan dan tulis keputusan.
text.en: Compare with a classmate's reading and write a conclusion.

feedback.ms: Bacaan rakan bukan had yang diluluskan.
feedback.en: A classmate's reading is not an approved limit.

situation.ms: Bacaan terkini anda berbeza daripada entri terdahulu dalam log.
situation.en: Your latest reading differs from the previous entry in the log.

text.ms: Padam entri terdahulu supaya log konsisten.
text.en: Erase the previous entry so the log is consistent.

feedback.ms: Jangan sekali-kali mengubah entri lama; ia menjejaskan kebolehkesanan.
feedback.en: Never alter earlier entries; it destroys traceability.

text.ms: Rekod bacaan terkini seperti ditemui dan laporkan perbezaan itu kepada orang diberi kuasa tanpa membuat kesimpulan trend.
text.en: Record the latest reading as found and report the difference to the authorised person without drawing a trend conclusion.

feedback.ms: Betul. Perbezaan dilaporkan; penilaian dibuat berdasarkan had yang diluluskan.
feedback.en: Correct. The difference is reported; judgement is made against approved limits.

text.ms: Anggap instrumen rosak dan jangan rekod bacaan.
text.en: Assume the instrument is faulty and do not record the reading.

feedback.ms: Rekod apa yang diperhatikan; status instrumen disahkan oleh orang diberi kuasa.
feedback.en: Record what you observed; the instrument's status is confirmed by the authorised person.

note.ms: Versi asal: lima titik dengan fungsi dan tujuan pembelajaran.
note.en: Original version: five points with function and learning purpose.

note.ms: Tambah pemerhatian, bukti, larangan, kesilapan biasa, semak cepat, status pengesahan, pautan video dan AR, senario serta metadata dwibahasa.
note.en: Added observations, evidence, do-nots, common mistakes, quick checks, verification status, video and AR links, scenarios and bilingual metadata.

unverifiedItems.ms: Kelajuan, suhu dan tekanan operasi sebenar, serta had yang diluluskan.
unverifiedItems.en: Actual operating speed, temperature and pressure, and approved limits.

sourcesNote.ms: Belum dibekalkan. Tambah lukisan, manual atau prosedur yang menjadi autoriti teknikal.
sourcesNote.en: Not yet supplied. Add the drawing, manual or procedure that is the technical authority.

text.ms: Melaksanakan pemeriksaan luaran dan merekod bacaan instrumen dengan tepat serta lengkap mengikut prosedur.
text.en: Carry out an external inspection and record instrument readings accurately and completely according to procedure.

text.ms: Mempamerkan amalan kerja selamat dan tanggungjawab semasa serahan rekod.
text.en: Demonstrate safe working practice and responsibility when handing over records.

text.ms: Menganalisis ketidakpastian bacaan dan mewajarkan keputusan berkaitan data yang direkod.
text.en: Analyse reading uncertainty and justify decisions about recorded data.

stcw.ms: Kod STCW, Jadual A-III/1: kompetensi "Maintain a safe engineering watch".
stcw.en: STCW Code, Table A-III/1: competence "Maintain a safe engineering watch".

aiDisclosure.ms: Kandungan ini disediakan dengan bantuan AI generatif dan mesti disemak oleh pakar bidang sebelum digunakan dalam pengajaran.
aiDisclosure.en: This content was prepared with generative AI assistance and must be reviewed by a subject-matter expert before use in teaching.

accessibility.ms: Sasaran nisbah kontras teks sekurang-kurangnya 4.5:1, boleh dikendalikan dengan papan kekunci, dan setiap ikon disertai teks.
accessibility.en: Target text contrast of at least 4.5:1, keyboard operable, and every icon accompanied by text.

disclaimer.ms: Model pembelajaran ilustratif. Bukan prosedur penyelenggaraan atau pemeriksaan yang diluluskan.
disclaimer.en: Illustrative learning model. Not an approved maintenance or inspection procedure.

note.ms: Aktifkan hanya selepas notis persetujuan pelajar dan kelulusan etika penyelidikan.
note.en: Enable only after a learner consent notice and research ethics approval.
